def contours(z,level):
 """Marching squares on a scalar field, returns closed polylines (row,column)."""
 z=np.asarray(z);mask=z>=level
 ys,xs=np.nonzero((mask[:-1,:-1]!=mask[1:,:-1])|(mask[:-1,:-1]!=mask[:-1,1:])|(mask[:-1,:-1]!=mask[1:,1:]))
 adj={};coords={}
 for y,x in zip(ys,xs):
  vals=[z[y,x],z[y,x+1],z[y+1,x+1],z[y+1,x]]
  keys=[('h',y,x),('v',y,x+1),('h',y+1,x),('v',y,x)]
  endpoints=[((y,x),(y,x+1)),((y,x+1),(y+1,x+1)),((y+1,x),(y+1,x+1)),((y,x),(y+1,x))]
  edges=[]
  for j,(a,b) in enumerate(endpoints):
   va=z[a];vb=z[b]
   if (va>=level)!=(vb>=level):
    key=keys[j];t=(level-va)/(vb-va);coords[key]=np.array(a)+(np.array(b)-a)*t;edges.append(key)
  pairs=[edges] if len(edges)==2 else ([edges[:2],edges[2:]] if len(edges)==4 else [])
  for a,b in pairs:adj.setdefault(a,[]).append(b);adj.setdefault(b,[]).append(a)
 loops=[];unused=set(adj)
 while unused:
  start=next(iter(unused));cur=start;prev=None;poly=[]
  while True:
   poly.append(coords[cur]);unused.discard(cur)
   nxt=[v for v in adj[cur] if v!=prev]
   if not nxt:break
   prev,cur=cur,nxt[0]
   if cur==start:poly.append(coords[cur]);break
   if len(poly)>len(adj)+2:raise RuntimeError('loop')
  if len(poly)>=4:loops.append(np.array(poly))
 return loops

def route(start,end,safe):
 a=tuple(np.rint(start).astype(int));b=tuple(np.rint(end).astype(int))
 # first try the straight segment
 test=np.linspace(start,end,int(np.linalg.norm(end-start)*2)+2)
 ij=np.rint(test).astype(int)
 if safe[ij[:,0],ij[:,1]].all():return [start,end]
 # A* within the eroded target; snap points just outside to it

 a=tuple(near[:,a[0],a[1]]);b=tuple(near[:,b[0],b[1]])
